artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
local function round_to(n: number, decimals: number): number
    local factor = 10 ^ decimals
    if n >= 0 then
        return math.floor(n * factor + 0.5) / factor
    else
        return math.ceil(n * factor - 0.5) / factor
    end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be 0" }
    end

    local change = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local pct = round_to(change, 2)

    local direction: string
    if current > initial then
        direction = "up"
    elseif current < initial then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percent change between initial and current values, rounded to 2 decimals with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a compact percent-change and direction ('up'/'down'/'flat') from two numeric values.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local segment: string = input.segment
    local inactive_days: number = input.inactive_days

    local list_r = tools.crm.list({ segment = segment })
    if not list_r or not list_r.ok then
        return { error = list_r and list_r.error or "listing_failed", message = list_r and list_r.message or "failed to list customers" }
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sends: number = 0

    for _, cust in list_r.customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= inactive_days then
            if sends >= 10 then
                break
            end
            local text: string = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
            local send_r = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            -- record success or failure for this recipient
            if send_r and send_r.ok then
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            end
            sends += 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

artifact.content:
local function celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius: number): number
    -- Formula: (°C × 9/5) + 32 = °F
    return celsius * (9 / 5) + 32
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Assume input.celsius is provided and numeric per schema.
    local c = input.celsius
    if typeof(c) ~= "number" then
        -- Defensive fallback: return 0°C -> 32°F when input is invalid
        c = 0
    end
    local f = celsius_to_fahrenheit(c)
    return { fahrenheit = f }
end

artifact.name: percentage_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function round(n: number, decimals: number): number
    local m = 10 ^ decimals
    if n >= 0 then
        return math.floor(n * m + 0.5) / m
    else
        return math.ceil(n * m - 0.5) / m
    end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    if input.initial_value == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local diff = input.current_value - input.initial_value
    local pct = (diff / input.initial_value) * 100
    local pct_rounded = round(pct, 2)

    local direction = "flat"
    if input.current_value > input.initial_value then
        direction = "up"
    elseif input.current_value < input.initial_value then
        direction = "down"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct_rounded, direction = direction }
end

artifact.name: list_segment_and_notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- list customers in the segment
    local res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not res.ok then
        return { error = res.error, message = res.message }
    end

    local candidates: { CustomerRef } = {}
    for i, cust in res.customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            table.insert(candidates, cust)
        end
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}

    local max_sends = 10
    local to_send = math.min(#candidates, max_sends)
    for i = 1, to_send do
        local c = candidates[i]
        local text = "Hi " .. c.name .. ", we miss you!"
        local r = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
        if not r.ok then
            table.insert(failed, c.id)
        else
            table.insert(notified, c.id)
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local raw = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local sign = raw >= 0 and 1 or -1
    local absval = raw * sign
    local rounded = math.floor(absval * 100 + 0.5) / 100 * sign

    local direction: string
    if rounded > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif rounded < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = rounded, direction = direction }
end

artifact.description: Fetch BTC and ETH prices in parallel, summarize the results and send a Telegram message with the aggregated summary.
